en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting
zh: 新增 `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS`，使无人值守重试模式（`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`）在遇到重置时间过远的用量限制时结束请求，而不是继续等待
